provenance: Transcribed by the Claude lane from the MATLAB Online command window (Bosco's account), 2026-09-30 ~02:55-03:00 IST; screenshots in evidence/. Numbers were computed INSIDE MATLAB; the Python traces were typed into MATLAB as integers (H2 x 1e10, ethanol x 1e9) and verified by checksum.
upstream: github.com/arcmateo/SSMR_Benchmark archive at commit c6280844404cbef38da8a893a095a734bc0d4815 (websave+unzip in MATLAB Drive/ssmr_native)
patches: Config lines only (Mode, Disturbance, Dist_time, initial_conditions, t, setpoint_profile, simulation_type) via regexprep on a copy run_<CASE>.m; STEP adds the input step line before the open-loop ode15s call (same as P5). Solver options, model, PID untouched. Plots produced by the script were closed.

fresh_session_results.note: Each closed-loop case preceded by `clear control` (resets persistent PID state). STEP is open loop.

STEP.IAE_note: Shown on screen (evidence 01 and 05) but not a gate: STEP is open loop, so IAE against the set-point is not a tracking metric, and the MATLAB integral ran over 41 rows (0-4.0 min) while the Python trace has 40 rows (0-3.9 min). The row-matched H2 comparison (max 0.0145% of nominal) is the equivalence evidence for STEP.

contaminated_first_session.note: Cases run back-to-back in one session (CS2T, CS2P, CS1, STEP). control.m keeps integral_error/prev_error as persistent variables and SSMR_simulation.m's `clear` does not reset them, so CS2P and CS1 inherited PID state. Kept as evidence of a reproducibility pitfall; not used for equivalence.

IC_last_rhs_test: From ICFull/Mode1_np50 with u_ss, one 0.1-min ode15s interval: F_H2 at IC = last-RHS = endpoint = last-RHS without NonNegative = 2.273536482e-04 (10 digits).
typed_checksums_note: Pairs are [sum(round(H2*1e10)), sum(round(EtOH*1e9))] of the typed Python vectors; MATLAB printed the same pairs (evidence 01), and they equal the sums recomputed from outputs/*/trace.csv.
clock_note: Clock times in this file are approximate (written from the session); file-system timestamps are authoritative.
